name: jacl-desktop
description: JACL desktop (Electron): the full web JACL hosted locally via cgijacl, with the map in its own window.

scripts.dist: npm run build-engine && npm run prepare-bundle && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build-engine && npm run prepare-bundle && electron-builder --mac
